new_cards.claim: An earlier global working default assigns cheky a MIDDLE_STAGE role. GDT749 withdraws the middle-stage preference in its outside comparison; GDT750 recalls that old default while assigning DRY to one locally licensed occurrence and leaving the general stage open. DRY and MIDDLE_STAGE are not logically exclusive without further model constraints; the source-reported conflict does not independently refute the earlier meaning. This preserves the historical form-wide stage hypothesis separately from the later local DRY role.

GDT749 revises the global working role of the complete form qochey toward an END/transition role, while retaining DRY/MIDDLE_STAGE as the strongest single serial-frame reading and HOT/END as a local rival. The evidence is a context-dependent whole-form working hypothesis, not a fixed quality translation, lexical identity, or confirmed meaning. Its global classifier failed calibration (23 true,42 false,60 missed labels), so the reported rank preference is retained as historical judgment and cannot independently confirm a meaning.

method_finding: The proposal states a semantic compositionality default with an unspecified exception mechanism. It names no manuscript component substitution, complete-form pair, override license, or independently observable response. Named historical surface contrasts exist, but the current rule entails no structural outcome separating transparency from whole-form lexicalization.
method_limit: A semantic override does not necessarily block written substitution; no entailed structural discriminator is yet defined. Meaning gold is not a blanket prerequisite for structural testing.
